description: Permanently delete a single memory from the local SQLite database by its ID. This action is irreversible — the row and its full-text search index entry are removed immediately. Use when a memory is outdated, incorrect, or no longer relevant. Returns {success: true} if the memory was found and deleted, or {success: false, message: 'Memory not found'} if the ID does not exist. Does not affect other memories or session records.

id.description: The UUID of the memory to delete. Obtain from store_memory, search_memory, or list_memories results.

name: delete_memory
